name: Merdeka 118
headline: height
description: Merdeka 118 is a 118-storey megatall skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, completed in 2023; the Skyscraper Center now lists it as Menara Merdeka Maybank. Its architectural height, including the spire, is 678.9 m (2,227 ft), and its tip reaches 680.5 m. It is the second-tallest building in the world after the Burj Khalifa and the tallest in Asia.

facts.text: It has 118 floors above ground and 5 below ground; construction started in 2014 and it was completed in 2023.
The Skyscraper Center ranks it the second-tallest building in the world and the tallest in Asia, Malaysia and Kuala Lumpur (September 2026).
Its core walls and mega-columns are reinforced concrete without embedded structural steel except at the outrigger trusses, which cut imported steel costs.
The developer is Permodalan Nasional Berhad, and the listed tenants include Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank).

sources.publisher: Council on Vertical Urbanism, formerly CTBUH (The Skyscraper Center)

caveats: The Skyscraper Center database now carries the Council on Vertical Urbanism (CVU) name; its height categories are the CTBUH ones (architectural top includes spires but not antennas).
The Skyscraper Center now lists the tower as Menara Merdeka Maybank; it is widely known as Merdeka 118.
World rankings change as new towers are completed; the ranks quoted are as shown on the Skyscraper Center in September 2026.
